newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Majestic studying White Range prospect.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Majestic studying White Range prospect.

text.p: Majestic Resources NL has postponed start-up of its White Range copper/cobalt project in western Queensland but is about to begin a feasibility study on the venture, director Grant Button told Reuters on Friday.
Last June, Majestic said it would start production at the project about mid-February, 1997.
"We're still looking to get it up and going," Button said on Friday. The project was now under review.
Feasibility studies would be carried out in the next couple of months and Majestic hoped to make an announcement on White Range in the next couple of weeks, he said.
It was not presently known when the venture might be brought into production, he said.

In December 1996 Majestic said it had substantially upgraded White Range and expected to produce an initial 8,800 tonnes of London Metal Exchange Grade A copper a year, raising it to 14,000 tonnes a year over two years.
White Range would also produce 150 to 250 tonnes of cobalt a year rising to 350 tonnes a year over two years, it said.
The project was originally due to start production in the first half of 1996.
